items.title: Anthropic's Claude can now orchestrate up to 1,000 AI agents in parallel through dynamic workflows
items.summary: Anthropic is adding dynamic workflows to Claude Managed Agents, letting a lead agent distribute tasks across up to 1,000 sub-agents at once. In testing, a single agent found at most 27 of 70 hidden bugs in a codebase, while the multi-agent workflow consistently caught 66. The article Anthropic's Claude can now orchestrate up to 1,000 AI agents in parallel through dynamic workflows appeared first on The Decoder .

Partners like CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks will help secure power grids and water systems, while a free AI scanner automatically checks open-source projects for vulnerabilities with an expected accuracy above 90 percent. The article Anthropic launches a free AI scanner for open-source projects appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Anthropic's Claude Science creates the first complete ultraviolet map of the sky
items.summary: Astrophysicist Brice Ménard of Johns Hopkins University used Anthropic's Claude Science to map the entire sky in ultraviolet light for the first time. AI agents downloaded data from multiple space missions, calibrated it, and filled in gaps using inpainting. Predictions averaged about ten percent deviation from actual measurements. Ménard sees the project as an example of research that simply wouldn't have gotten done without AI. The article Anthropic's Claude Science creates the first complete ultraviolet map of the sky appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 約翰霍普金斯大學的天文物理學家布里斯・梅納德（Brice Ménard）首次使用 Anthropic's Claude Science 繪製了全天候的紫外線地圖。AI 代理從多個太空任務下載資料、進行校準，並利用圖像修補技術填補空白。預測結果與實際測量的偏差平均約為百分之十。梅納德認為這個專案是一個如果沒有 AI 就絕對無法完成的研究範例。本文 Anthropic's Claude Science creates the first complete ultraviolet map of the sky 最早發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: OpenAI uncovers Russian and Iranian influence ops that planted fake stories in real news outlets
items.summary: OpenAI exposed a Russian and an Iranian influence operation and banned the accounts involved. The Russian "Dark Clark" campaign spread disinformation across Latin America and drew reactions from politicians, earning the first category 5 out of 6 rating in OpenAI's reporting history. The Iranian "Bogus Bylines" operation used seven fake journalists to place nearly 100 articles in online outlets worldwide. The article OpenAI uncovers Russian and Iranian influence ops that planted fake stories in real news outlets appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 揭露了一項俄羅斯和一項伊朗的影響力行動，並封禁了相關帳戶。俄羅斯的「暗克拉克」（Dark Clark）活動在拉丁美洲散佈虛假資訊並引起政治人物的反應，在 OpenAI's 報導史上首次獲得 6 級中的第 5 級評分。伊朗的「虛假署名」（Bogus Bylines）行動則利用七名假記者在全球的網路媒體上刊登了近 100 篇文章。本文 OpenAI uncovers Russian and Iranian influence ops that planted fake stories in real news outlets 最早發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: Anthropic 攜手天文學家，Claude AI 填補空白打造首張全天紫外地圖
